description: [Migawari] Free-text intake for a need in Japan that fits NONE of the eight catalog services (see list_services). Describe what you need done in your own words. A human operator reads every submission and answers — either with a priced quote (the need is converted into the normal quote/task flow) or with a message. There is NO instant price and NO promise of execution; submitting is free. This is not a catalog service and has no handling fee of its own. Privacy: the text you submit is read by a human operator and retained so the operator can answer and so recurring needs can improve the service catalogue — do not include personal data you cannot share. The response includes an access_token shown only once; store it to read the answer via get_need_status.

budget_jpy.description: Optional: the budget you have in mind, in JPY. A guide for the operator, not a price.

contact.description: Optional: a return channel the operator can use (email, URL, handle) if you want an answer outside this record.

context.description: Optional: what you are trying to achieve overall — the background that helps the operator judge fit and price.

deadline.description: Optional: any deadline, in free text (e.g. 'before 2026-12-24'). Nothing is promised against it.

request.description: What you need done in Japan, in free text (1-4000 characters). Be concrete: what, where, and what 'done' looks like.

test_mode.description: If true, the submission is a rehearsal: it is stored but the operator is not notified.

name: migawari__request_anything
title: Describe any need in Japan (free text)
